description: A dark painterly office at night with a desk, lamp, candle, ledgers and papers feeding two paper shredders that spill strips. Through a large window is a wet airfield with a four-engine cargo plane, a forklift, a few figures, and an open wooden crate holding a missile in straw. The crate side carries stencilled lettering reading roughly MILITARY MILITARY and a code like SGN-71.
